Captions – Headings

Chapter headings, section captions and similar catchlines are included in this code for the convenience of the reader and are not part of the code or a title in any manner as would limit or restrict the scope or operation of the language of any provision.

Date Passed: Monday, January 22, 2007

Effective Date: Sunday, March 4, 2007

Recodification ORD C33969 Section 1
